answer.short:
Heights: $0,7,0,0$. Mean: $1.75$.
Split the remaining $3$ blocks into quarters and share them equally.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\bar{x}&=\frac{0+7+0+0}{4}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{7}{4}\\\bar{x}&=1.75\end{align*}$$
Split the remaining $3$ blocks into quarters: each tower has one whole block and three quarters.
